Package com.squad93.pos.ui

Record Class OrderItemSelection

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.squad93.pos.ui.OrderItemSelection
Record Components:
product - selected drink and its displayed base price
iceLevel - selected ice choice
sugarLevel - selected sugar percentage
quantity - positive number of identically customized drinks
toppings - extra servings per drink; repeated options represent additional servings
public record OrderItemSelection(Product product, String iceLevel, int sugarLevel, int quantity, List<ToppingOption> toppings) extends Record
Captures one drink configuration and its quantity before checkout starts. Each topping entry represents one extra serving per drink, and repeated entries are allowed. Ice and sugar choices are retained here and validated when the checkout request is built.
Author:
Arman Singh, Daniel Izmerly, Tejas Kalpathi

    • OrderItemSelection

      public OrderItemSelection(Product product, String iceLevel, int sugarLevel, int quantity, List<ToppingOption> toppings)
      Validates the drink and quantity and takes an immutable copy of the toppings.
      Parameters:
      product - the selected drink
      iceLevel - the selected ice level
      sugarLevel - the selected sugar percentage
      quantity - the number of drinks
      toppings - the topping servings per drink
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the product is null or the quantity is not positive

      public BigDecimal lineTotal()
      Calculates the base drink price plus all extra servings, multiplied by drink quantity. No rounding, tax, or tip is applied at the line level.
